title.narrative: Enhanced enabling measures for creating decent jobs and rural economy development

description.narrative: Iraq faces a job crisis. After years of conflict, the country has one of the lowest employment-to-population ratios in the region. Unemployment is particularly high among women, youth and displaced communities. Limited growth in the private sector is a key barrier to largescale job creation, exacerbated by a vocational training system in need of reform. Policy development has been stymied by lack of comprehensive and up-to-date labour market data. But now, following the publication of the Labour Force Survey (LFS), the effort towards the development of a national employment policy is underway.
